source: Canonical MOD_METADATA.json files in the public intellistream StateAxis topic repositories

components.name: StateAxis ACL Graph Dispatcher
components.summary_en: Identity-bound ACL Graph capability dispatch for admitted Qwen2 decode shapes. Historical matched evidence was negative; current online qualification remains pending.
components.summary_zh: 面向已准入 Qwen2 Decode shape 的身份绑定 ACL Graph 能力分派。历史配对结果为负，当前在线资格仍待验证。

components.name: StateAxis Chunked Prefill
components.summary_en: Token-budgeted chunked prefill for mixed long-prefill and decode contention. Evidence is workload-scoped positive and experimental, not general qualification.
components.summary_zh: 针对长 Prefill 与 Decode 混合竞争的 token-budget 分块 Prefill。证据仅在特定负载中为正，仍属实验性。

components.name: StateAxis Device Metadata Delta
components.summary_en: Device-resident metadata deltas for decode batches with stable state identity and sparse block-table growth. Performance qualification is pending.
components.summary_zh: 面向稳定状态身份与稀疏 block-table 增长 Decode batch 的设备侧元数据增量机制，性能尚未验证。

components.name: StateAxis Dynamic Microbatch
components.summary_en: Dynamic dual-microbatch overlap for greedy B16 decode. Tested cells failed correctness, so no performance claim is admitted.
components.summary_zh: 面向 greedy B16 Decode 的动态双微批重叠。已测单元未通过正确性，因此不声明性能收益。

components.name: StateAxis Host-tier Residency
components.summary_en: Generation-safe host-tier offload and exact request-state restore under device slot pressure. Historical prefetch and restore cells were not beneficial.
components.summary_zh: 设备状态槽压力下的 generation-safe Host 层卸载与请求状态精确恢复。历史预取与恢复单元没有收益。

components.name: StateAxis Identity-bound INT8 KV
components.name_zh: StateAxis 身份绑定 INT8 KV
components.summary_en: Identity-bound INT8 KV storage and write-volume exploration. Component evidence was positive, but full-model accuracy failed its gate.
components.summary_zh: 身份绑定的 INT8 KV 存储与写入量探索。组件证据为正，但整模型精度未通过门禁。

components.name: StateAxis Incremental Eviction
components.summary_en: Generation-safe bitmap eviction indexing for bounded resident states. Matched real-online evidence is mixed and remains unqualified.
components.summary_zh: 面向有界驻留状态的 generation-safe bitmap 淘汰索引。真实在线配对证据结果混合，尚未取得资格。

components.name: StateAxis Launch Fusion
components.summary_en: Identity-bound physical-B32 full-MLP launch fusion. Historical component evidence is inconclusive and current online qualification is pending.
components.summary_zh: 身份绑定的 physical-B32 全 MLP launch 融合。历史组件证据不确定，当前在线资格仍待验证。

components.name: StateAxis Length-aware Queue
components.summary_en: Length-tiered scheduling for varied-length cold-prefill queues. The mechanism is currently unqualified.
components.summary_zh: 面向不同长度冷 Prefill 队列的长度分层调度机制，目前尚未验证。

components.name: StateAxis Multi-LoRA Residency
components.summary_en: Identity, isolation and bounded host/HBM residency for heterogeneous LoRA batches. Correctness passed; the frozen candidate was 0.405% slower, so no gain is claimed.
components.summary_zh: 异构 LoRA batch 的身份、隔离及有界 Host/HBM 驻留。正确性通过；冻结候选慢 0.405%，不声明收益。

components.name: StateAxis On-device Sampling
components.summary_en: Device-side categorical sampling, logits processing and bounded beam ranking. Historical fresh-process real-NPU evidence was negative.
components.summary_zh: 设备侧分类采样、logits 处理与有界 beam 排序。历史 fresh-process 真实 NPU 证据为负。

components.name: StateAxis One-step Scheduling
components.summary_en: Same-turn exact plan/forward authority for reviewed request and state budgets. It was not beneficial in the tested cell.
components.summary_zh: 在已审查请求与状态预算下提供同一 turn 的精确 plan/forward 权限；已测单元没有收益。

components.name: StateAxis Preemption Recompute
components.summary_en: Generation-safe request preemption and deterministic recompute under hard state-slot pressure. The matched real-NPU cell violated the no-harm gate.
components.summary_zh: 硬状态槽压力下 generation-safe 请求抢占与确定性重算；真实 NPU 配对单元违反 no-harm 门禁。

components.name: StateAxis Program-aware Scheduling
components.summary_en: Attained-service scheduling for generation-bound agent programs with fan-out and explicit session close. Historical evidence is negative and version-unqualified.
components.summary_zh: 面向 generation-bound Agent 程序、并发 fan-out 与显式 session close 的 attained-service 调度；历史证据为负且版本未验证。

components.name: StateAxis Session Lifecycle
components.summary_en: Session-aware state reuse, explicit close and bounded holder lifetime. Historical evidence is mixed and version-unqualified.
components.summary_zh: 会话感知的状态复用、显式关闭与有界 holder 生命周期；历史证据结果混合且版本未验证。

components.name: StateAxis Shared-prefix Attention
components.summary_en: Fork-cohort attention for sibling decode generations sharing an exact block-aligned prefix. Historical component evidence is negative.
components.summary_zh: 面向共享精确 block-aligned 前缀的 sibling Decode generation 的 fork-cohort attention；历史组件证据为负。

components.name: StateAxis Sleep / Wake
components.summary_en: Idle-only whole-worker resource release and exact wake reassembly. Historical Qwen2.5 evidence released 51,653 MiB with 35.892 s wake p95; this is not inference speedup.
components.summary_zh: 仅空闲时执行的整 worker 资源释放与精确唤醒重组。历史 Qwen2.5 证据释放 51,653 MiB，唤醒 p95 为 35.892 秒；这不是推理加速。

components.name: StateAxis Speculative Decoding
components.summary_en: Identity-bound physical-B32 target verification for draft widths K1-K8. Component evidence is positive, while the prompt-lookup online upper bound was negative.
components.summary_zh: 面向 draft width K1-K8 的身份绑定 physical-B32 target verification。组件证据为正，但 prompt-lookup 在线上界为负。

components.name: StateAxis Typed Hybrid State Groups
components.name_zh: StateAxis 类型化混合状态组
components.summary_en: Transactional lifecycle and release/reuse authority for typed recurrent plus full-KV state groups. Hardware qualification is pending.
components.summary_zh: 类型化 recurrent 与 full-KV 状态组的事务化生命周期及释放/复用权限，硬件资格仍待验证。

components.name: StateAxis Workflow-disaggregated Residency
components.summary_en: Request-level residency decision and recovery contract scoped by workflow identity. Local recovery is functionally validated; no remote transport or speedup is claimed.
components.summary_zh: 以 workflow identity 为作用域的请求级驻留决策与恢复合同。本地恢复已通过功能验证，不声明远端传输或加速。
